title: Perhaps hanging clothes out to dry. The maid was in the garden
html_source:
From ‘Sing a Song of Sixpence’:

The maid was in the garden
Hanging out the clothes
When down came a blackbird
And pecked off her nose.

anchor.prefix:
on the bed. 

 Listening, he heard her voice: 

 — Come, come, pussy. Come. 

 He went out through the backdoor into the garden: stood to listen towards the next garden. No sound.
anchor.suffix:
. Fine morning. 

 He bent down to regard a lean file of spearmint growing by the wall. Make a summerhouse here. Scarlet runners. Virginia creepers. Want to manure the whole place
